# PDF.js

`pdf.mjs` and `pdf.worker.mjs` are respectively `build/pdf.min.mjs` and `build/pdf.worker.min.mjs` from the official [`pdfjs-dist@5.4.296`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/5.4.296) distribution. The filenames were shortened to match the extension’s import paths. The files are unmodified.

See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for the bundled dependency’s Apache 2.0 license.
